replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: The Hawaii comparison is exact. Mauritius sits on the Reunion hotspot, the same kind of mantle plume that built the Hawaiian chain. The island started forming about 9 million years ago, and the hotspot has since drifted under Reunion, which is why the volcanoes there are still active while Mauritius is quiet.
